powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$s=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('ChecklistDeploy-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.ps1');try{$b=[Convert]::FromBase64String('');$m=New-Object IO.MemoryStream(,$b);$g=New-Object IO.Compression.GZipStream($m,[IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress);$r=New-Object IO.StreamReader($g);$t=$r.ReadToEnd();$r.Dispose();[IO.File]::WriteAllText($s,$t,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8);& $s}catch{Add-Content (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'Checklist-PORTO-bootstrap.log') $_;exit 1}finally{Remove-Item -LiteralPath $s -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}"
